permutationLabel: Typed complaint, lump frame with reducibility
summary: 45-year-old man: 4 months of a lump in the right groin that goes back on lying down, with a cough impulse; aches after heavy lifting.

inputs.hpi: Four months of a soft lump in the right groin, bigger when standing and after heavy lifting at work, gone when lying down. He can push it back. A cough makes it bulge. Aches at the end of the day. Never painful or stuck. No vomiting, bowels normal.

exam.other: Right groin: reducible swelling above and medial to the pubic tubercle with a cough impulse. Testes normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Right inguinal hernia
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Reducible right inguinal hernia with cough impulse.

socratesAnswers.reducibility: Cough impulse, Reducible, Reduces on lying down

mustRankTopK.note: Lump frame: site right inguinal, cough impulse, reducible (web: groin_swelling, cough_impulse, groin_lump_reducible).

guideline.name: International guidelines for groin hernia management (HerniaSurge)
guideline.section: Diagnosis is clinical; reducible hernia with a cough impulse; elective repair

rationale: The lump frame asks reducibility and cough impulse — not radiation or 'what is it like'. A typed complaint without a template now gets that frame on both platforms.
